text: ビビってるんじゃないよ！

structure.jp: ビビってるんじゃないよ！

patterns.name: 〜のではない
patterns.span: ビビってるんじゃない
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by んじゃない, said firmly, is a scolding 'don't do that'. んじゃ is the spoken short form of のでは. ビビってるんじゃない = 'don't be getting scared'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something going on now; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. ビビってる = 'are being scared'.
